articles.title: Trump threatens EU will pay ‘big price’ after Brussels fines Google $1bn - Al Jazeera
articles.description: EU accuses US tech giant of favouring its own services in search results, as Trump lashes out against bloc.
articles.content: United States President Donald Trump has threatened the European Union with steep tariffs and a new trade investigation, saying that the bloc will pay a very big price after Brussels fined Google $1b… [+2402 chars]
